page.layout: One page of running text, single column of numbered theses, each number on its own line above its thesis. No margin notes. Catchword at the lower right.

p.i: Perpetua, est quæ semper necessario in universis Ecclesiis immutabiliter observari debet.

main_text.p: Qualis est traditio Baptismi & Cœnæ Domini. De illo ait Basilius lib. 3 contra Eunom. Hoc palàm oppugnat sacri Baptismatis traditionem, Euntes baptizate in nomine Patris & Filij & Spiritus sancti. De hac verò Paulus 1. Cor. 11.23. Ego enim accepi à Domino, quod & tradidi vobis, Dominum Iesum videlicet, eâ nocte qua proditus est, accepisse panem, &c.
Traditio temporaria, est quæ pro circumstantiarum ratione mutari potest, ac propterea libera ejus est observatio ac nequaquam absolute necessaria.

Qualis fuit Apostolica traditio de abstinentia à sanguine & suffocato. Act. 15. 28. 29. & 16.4. Paulus & Timotheus tradebant Ecclesijs servanda instituta illa quæ decreta fuerat ab Apostolis & Presbyteris q; Hierosolymis erat.

Quales fuerunt traditiones, quæ ad εὐταξίαν[?] & externam politiam in Ecclesiasticis conventibus servandam pertinue-runt: de quib. loquitur Paulus 1. Cor. 11. 2. Laudo verò vos, fratres, quòd omnia mea meministis, & sicut tradidi vobis, traditiones retinetis.
SECUNDO' traditio vel divina est vel humana.
Traditio divina, est quæ á Deo Ecclesia est commendata per Prophetas & Apostolos.
Eaq; vel scripta est vel non scripta.

page.notes: Printed numbers "IIX." (for VIII) and "Qualesfuerunt" (run together) are copied as printed. The Greek word after "ad" in thesis X is doubtful and marked [?]. Thesis XI, "SECVNDO'", is set in small capitals and is copied as SECUNDO' with u for the vowel. Long s is written as s throughout. The Greek in thesis X is only approximate. The catchword "Traditio" is at the lower right. No running head, page number or signature is printed. Faint show-through of the reverse page is ignored.
